title: OpenSpore / implementation ledger
subtitle: Spore: Galactic Adventures (x86) - disassembly-driven reimplementation
status_note: Bounded checklist, not game completion. done = implemented/verified or an explicitly evidence-only finding verified; partial = incomplete implementation or evidence; todo = not implemented. Counts have unequal task sizes. UI transitions do not count as gameplay. Regenerate PNG, Markdown and stats with tools/feature_map.py.

features.name: state chain drains per frame

A queued hop is now guaranteed to be attempted, and reentry is still refused.

features.name: spui token alphabet
features.note: GA 0x82b3f0: id:u32/type:u16/count:u16; 19=count u16 object indexes, FFFF=null; 20=struct metadata then nested properties; 18=UTF-16 or table/key. Object marker 5FF5 is real, not a type code. Unknown ids preserve framing. 748/748 exact EOF.

features.name: layout -> locale table

features.name: uilayout's two trailing ids
features.note: ARG1 IDENTIFIED: 0x027996d8 is a CONTROL ID of E3LaunchScreen, present in BOTH shipped copies (PatchData and Spore_Graphics). ARG2 0x0279bf9e is NOT a control id in any of the 748 layout resources, is in no resource id field of all 150,945 records, and no registry name hashes to it. So `uilayout -load <name> <control_id> <?>` is addressed by (layout, control) and one operand is still unknown - stated with its size, not guessed at.

features.name: spui precedence (resource cache)
features.note: Presentation policies, not recovered priority: SPUI/PNG keep first key, locale uses last parsed. Surface: 18 SPUI layout size differences and 3 locale text conflicts. A spelling fix does not establish original precedence.

The third depth was invisible for two sessions because the search was scoped by FILENAME (*Spore_EP1_Locale*) instead of by TYPE.

features.name: caption gaps classified
features.note: spui -gaps splits the 42 unresolved refs into COVERAGE (table instance absent from the corpus: mvj 0x277DEE6A, 14 keys) and SEMANTIC (table present, key missing: 4 keys). `legal` 0xADB810C4 was on the missing list for two sessions and is NOT missing - it ships in PatchData's nested packages.

features.name: intra-resource repeated key
